description: Exact published actions read from the operator-selected chromezip Gallery version. Historical lab snapshot, not approval for another environment or a hardened replacement.
validation: Operator reported successful portal addition and CLI removal on a new machine. Portal deletion remains unresolved.

manageActions.install: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Expand-Archive -LiteralPath ChromeSetup.zip -DestinationPath chrome_x -Force; $e=(Get-ChildItem chrome_x -Recurse -Filter *.exe | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; if (-not $e) { throw 'Installer exe not found in zip' }; $p=Start-Process $e -ArgumentList '/silent','/install' -PassThru; $p.WaitForExit(); $c=Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'; $d=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(10); while (-not (Test-Path $c) -and (Get-Date) -lt $d) { Start-Sleep 5 }; if (-not (Test-Path $c)) { throw 'Chrome not installed - ChromeSetup.exe needs internet access from the VM' }; exit 0"
manageActions.remove: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$c=Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $c)) { exit 0 }; Get-Process chrome -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; $k=Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall','HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Get-ItemProperty | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq 'Google Chrome' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($k -and $k.PSChildName -like '{*}') { Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList '/x',$k.PSChildName,'/qn','/norestart' -Wait } else { $s=(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Google\Chrome\Application\*\Installer\setup.exe') | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; if ($s) { $p=Start-Process $s -ArgumentList '--uninstall','--system-level','--force-uninstall' -PassThru; $p.WaitForExit() } }; $d=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(5); while ((Test-Path $c) -and (Get-Date) -lt $d) { Start-Sleep 3 }; if (Test-Path $c) { throw 'Chrome still present after uninstall' }; exit 0"
